notes: Layer 2 page features. Single implementation: extension/src/lib/pagefeatures.ts (collectRaw runs on the live DOM in the content script and on jsdom in training; finalize runs in the offscreen document and in training).

page_features.name: form_action_external
page_features.desc: A form with a sensitive field submits to a different registered domain

page_features.name: form_action_to_official
page_features.desc: That external action domain is an official domain of a known brand (SSO-like)

page_features.name: form_action_unusual_scheme
page_features.desc: Sensitive form action uses mailto:, javascript:, data: or is an IP host

page_features.name: external_resource_ratio
page_features.desc: Scripts/images/styles from other registered domains / all resources

page_features.name: external_link_ratio
page_features.desc: Links to other registered domains / all links

page_features.name: null_link_ratio
page_features.desc: Links that go nowhere (#, javascript:) / all links

page_features.name: brand_in_title_not_official
page_features.desc: Title or og:site_name names a brand whose official domains do not include this site

page_features.name: brand_in_text_not_official
page_features.desc: Visible text names such a brand

page_features.name: resources_from_brand_domain
page_features.desc: Page loads resources (e.g. logo) from the official domain of a brand it is not

page_features.name: hidden_iframes
page_features.desc: Iframes with width/height <= 1 or hidden via attributes/inline style

page_features.name: urgency_phrase_count
page_features.desc: Multilingual urgency phrases found (en, hi, pt, id, es)

page_features.name: text_length
page_features.desc: Characters of visible text sampled (capped at 5000)
